author: Palmetto State News
title: 281 Furman student-athletes named to Southern Conference academic honor roll
text:
281 Furman student-athletes named to Southern Conference academic honor roll
A total of 281 Furman University student-athletes were named to the 2025-26 Southern Conference Academic Honor Roll, according to a July 15 announcement from the league office. The selections represent all 18 intercollegiate sports offered by Furman during the academic year and ranked third among all schools in the conference.
The Southern Conference Academic Honor Roll was established in the 1988-89 academic year by conference athletic directors to recognize outstanding student-athletes. To qualify, student-athletes must have participated in varsity sports, posted a grade point average of at least 3.0 for the academic year, been eligible for the entire year, and appeared on final squad lists.
Thirty-two Furman athletes achieved perfect 4.0 grade point averages for the school year. Among them are Wesley Abraham (football), Noah Akinsola (football), Walker Allen (men's tennis), Walter Anderson (men's golf), Katie Bengough (women's soccer), Bruce Brown (football), Joshua Burrell (football), Ansley Chiang (softball), Riley Clark (football), Briyah Drayton (women's soccer), and others across multiple sports.
Seventy-eight Furman student-athletes received the SoCon Commissioner's Medal, which is awarded to those who maintained a GPA of at least 3.8 during the academic year.
Across all member institutions, there were a total of 2,698 selections to this year's Academic Honor Roll—the second-highest total in league history. Of these honorees, 863 earned Commissioner's Medals and 282 recorded perfect GPAs.
